# Parakeet v3 header contract fixture

This fixture retains the checkpoint configuration and 723 tensor shapes from the existing
Parakeet v3 contract. It contains no weights, local paths or machine-run receipts. It is used by
`tests/test_parakeet.py` for the pure shape contract. The original complete receipt remains in
ignored `qualification/results/`.

Original receipt SHA-256: `198244933551013c5ad39a7157652cd0ef1ba242dcadee7032ab55bc105b3010`.
